description: Seed20 grammatical-mathematics candidate corpus. 20 models selected from Base120, with experimental signatures, 20x20 pair matrix, and 15 gold experiments. This is NOT canonical. No promotion without external human approval.

compose.name: sequential ladder
compose.description: Sequential composition: output of A feeds into B.

parallel.name: parallel lattice
parallel.description: Parallel composition: A and B run concurrently, results joined.

map.name: explicit collection lift
map.description: Explicit named lift of a model over a collection. Never silent.

closure.name: closure
closure.description: Close over a model's output to create a reusable abstraction.

fixedpoint.name: recursive/fixed-point
fixedpoint.description: Recursive application until fixpoint, bounded depth 1..3.

barrier.name: type barrier
barrier.description: No valid composition exists. Type incompatibility.

gold_experiments.name: Seed instantiation
gold_experiments.description: Foundational candidate. Instantiate a single Seed20 model and verify it resolves through canonical getModelByCode.
gold_experiments.semantic_finding: Seed instantiation produces a valid Frame output from P1 First Principles Framing.

gold_experiments.name: Type barrier
gold_experiments.description: IN18 Kill-Criteria -> RE8 Bootstrapping is a type barrier. Terminate-then-generate is type-invalid.
gold_experiments.semantic_finding: Kill-criteria applied before bootstrapping creates a type barrier: you cannot terminate a process that has not yet been generated.

gold_experiments.name: Lattice correction with join
gold_experiments.description: CO1 Synergy -> CO5 Emergence is a parallel lattice that requires an explicit join.
gold_experiments.semantic_finding: Parallel composition of synergy and emergence requires an explicit named join to produce a coherent composite output.

gold_experiments.name: Context-decomposition commutator
gold_experiments.description: P10 Context Windowing -> DE11 Scope Delimitation vs DE11 -> P10. Noncommutative. The forward direction is a map (collection lift of context over decomposed parts).
gold_experiments.semantic_finding: Context-then-decompose and decompose-then-context produce different results. The commutator [P10, DE11] is non-zero.

gold_experiments.name: Double problem reversal
gold_experiments.description: IN3 Problem Reversal -> IN3 Problem Reversal. Non-involutive: double reversal is not identity.
gold_experiments.semantic_finding: Applying problem reversal twice does not return to the original problem. The reversal operator is not an involution.

gold_experiments.name: Context idempotence
gold_experiments.description: P10 Context Windowing -> P10 Context Windowing. Conditional idempotence.
gold_experiments.semantic_finding: Context windowing is idempotent only when the window boundaries are stable. If the context shifts between applications, the result differs.

gold_experiments.name: System-boundary idempotence
gold_experiments.description: SY2 System Boundaries -> SY2 System Boundaries. Conditional idempotence.
gold_experiments.semantic_finding: System boundary application is idempotent only when the boundary definition is stable. If the system evolves between applications, the boundary shifts.

gold_experiments.name: Decompose-recompose conservation
gold_experiments.description: DE1 Root Cause -> CO5 Emergence. Partial conservation: recomposing after decomposition does not fully restore the original.
gold_experiments.semantic_finding: Decompose-then-recompose loses information about inter-component relationships. Conservation is partial, not total.

gold_experiments.name: Governance-telemetry order
gold_experiments.description: SY11 Governance Patterns -> SY18 Measurement & Telemetry vs SY18 -> SY11. Noncommutative.
gold_experiments.semantic_finding: Governance-then-telemetry (instrument after designing rules) and telemetry-then-governance (design rules from observed data) produce different system behaviors.

gold_experiments.name: Boundary alternation
gold_experiments.description: IN7 Boundary Testing -> SY2 System Boundaries. Candidate relation.
gold_experiments.semantic_finding: Testing boundaries then defining system boundaries is a valid candidate composition. The relation is hypothesis-level, not confirmed.

gold_experiments.name: Recursive meta-model selection
gold_experiments.description: RE6 Recursive Framing -> SY19 Meta-Model Selection. Local fixed point.
gold_experiments.semantic_finding: Recursively framing the selection of a meta-model reaches a local fixed point: the framing stabilizes on a meta-model that can frame its own selection.

gold_experiments.name: Generate then terminate
gold_experiments.description: RE8 Bootstrapping -> IN18 Kill-Criteria. Order-constrained: valid in this order only.
gold_experiments.semantic_finding: Generate-then-terminate is valid. The reverse (terminate-then-generate, GM-001) is a type barrier. The order constraint is fundamental.

gold_experiments.name: Recursive evaluator governance
gold_experiments.description: RE20 Recursive Governance applied to the evaluator itself. Valid but requires external authorization.
gold_experiments.semantic_finding: Recursive governance of the evaluator is valid but cannot self-authorize. External human approval is required for ratification.

gold_experiments.name: Output vs receipt equivalence
gold_experiments.description: Verify that the experiment output and the promotion receipt are distinct. The receipt is not the output.
gold_experiments.semantic_finding: The experiment output (semantic finding) and the promotion receipt (six-field metadata) are distinct artifacts. Equivalence is not expected; distinction is preserved.

gold_experiments.name: Reduce/search commutator
gold_experiments.description: DE5 Dimensional Reduction -> DE7 Pareto Decomposition vs DE7 -> DE5. Noncommutative.
gold_experiments.semantic_finding: Reduce-then-Pareto and Pareto-then-reduce produce different decompositions. The commutator [DE5, DE7] is non-zero.
